name: Swatch — No-Signup Palette Organizer
description: Extract colors from any webpage into named palettes. Export as CSS, Tailwind config, or Figma tokens. No account required.

_permission_justifications.storage: Stores the user's extracted color palettes, palette names, and cached plan status in chrome.storage.local. Nothing about the pages the user visits is stored on any external server except an anonymous paid-status check.
_permission_justifications.activeTab: Grants temporary access to the tab the user is currently viewing only when they click the extension icon and then click "Extract Colors" inside the popup. No access is requested to any other tab, and no access persists after the popup closes.
_permission_justifications.scripting: Used together with activeTab to run a single, one-shot, read-only color scan (reading computed CSS color/background-color/border-color values) on the active tab when the user explicitly clicks "Extract Colors". The injected function only reads styles and returns a list of hex colors — it never modifies the page and is not injected automatically on page load.
